description: This file defines the Lifecycle interface for managing component lifecycle operations (start and stop) within the Eclipse Hono service-based architecture. It specifies method signatures returning Vert.x Future objects to handle asynchronous startup and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: Lifecycle
classes.description: An interface declaring lifecycle management methods (start and stop) for components.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates startup procedures for the component; returns a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Initiates shutdown procedures for the component; returns a Future indicating success or failure.
